scenes.title: Choose your rendering flow.
lines: Scene input first. Reconstructed output next.
scenes.narration: Choose how neural rendering fits into your flight. Before upscaling is the recommended default. Neural rendering edits the scene input first, then F S R reconstructs the output.

scenes.title: Compare either order live.
lines: Processing order: Before or After upscaling
After uses output resolution and may cost more GPU time
scenes.narration: Open N R settings and choose Processing order. Switch between Before and After upscaling without restarting the simulator. Your choice is saved. After processes the larger output image and may need substantially more G P U time.

scenes.title: Give the scene time to settle.
lines: NR and FG wait for the initial scene to settle
Lower-priority NR preparation · Selected pass budget only
FG keeps real frames visible when matching input is unavailable
scenes.narration: Optional neural rendering and frame generation wait for the initial scene to settle. Model preparation uses lower C P U priority and allocates the selected pass budget. If matching generation input is unavailable, the real frame stays visible while generation recovers. This does not increase base frame rate or remove all artifacts.

scenes.title: Consistent color in motion.
lines: Display color stays consistent between real and generated SDR frames
Optional synchronized compatibility pacing for FSR 3 and 4
Compatibility may cost performance · FG remains experimental
scenes.narration: Frame generation now preserves consistent display color between real and generated S D R frames. Optional synchronized compatibility modes offer a second presentation path for F S R three and four. These modes may cost performance. Frame generation remains experimental.

scenes.title: Follow the current session.
lines: Live NR status shows processing order and resolution
Clear states for active, protected and waiting processing
scenes.narration: Live neural rendering status shows the active order and resolution. Open Renderer log to follow the current session automatically. Clear activity and waiting states help you understand when processing is running or protected.

scenes.title: Get every current feature.
lines: Update to Normal for all current features
Start with Subtle strength, one pass and FG Off
Skip anytime · Replay from What’s new
scenes.narration: Update to the Normal release for all current features. Neural rendering needs compatible R D N A four hardware and your own supported local model. Start with Subtle strength, one pass and frame generation off. Skip this guide anytime, or replay it from Whats New.
